# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.9

This developer prerelease makes cold opens about twice as fast. The public query
operations remain `verify`, `search`, `read`, `check`, and `status`.

## Changes

- Opening an Ont validates the native object map read back from storage with
  `validateStoredSourceNativeObjectMap`: shape, counts and cross-references are
  checked, but nested content hashes (field, object, identity, map) are not
  re-derived. The map bytes must still match the manifest's stored digest, and
  the build validated the map fully before writing it. Builds, `check` and all
  other callers still validate fully, and a full open still refuses invalid
  field evidence.
- Measured on a 491-source, 3,500-object Ont: cold open 680 ms to 300 ms.

## Install

```sh
npm install https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.9/oont-0.3.0-alpha.9.tgz
```
